name: Laplacian Pyramid
definition: A decomposition scheme for images (and volumes) that removes high correlations between neighboring pixels to achieve compression. It decomposes data into a set of sequences corresponding to distinct ranges of spatial frequency using local operators of many scales but identical shape as basis functions.
summary: The Laplacian Pyramid is a multiresolution decomposition that represents volume data using detail residuals between Gaussian pyramid levels, enabling efficient compression by decorrelating signals.
